abilities.effect: The spirit shoves the furniture over in an attempt to crush the triggering creature. The triggering creature takes 2d10+7 bludgeoning damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save). On a failure, the creature is additionally knocked prone.
abilities.name: Topple Furniture
abilities.trigger: A creature moves adjacent to the furniture

hazard.description: A mischievous spirit pushes a bookshelf over onto a creature.
hazard.disable: DC 16 Athletics to hold the furniture upright or DC 18 Occultism (trained) to foil the spirit's efforts to influence matter
hazard.name: Toppling Furniture
hazard.reset: If the haunt successfully damages a creature with Topple Furniture, the spirit laughs for 1d4 rounds as the haunt resets; each subsequent time the haunt activates, it must topple a different piece of upright furniture. If the haunt fails to damage a creature, the spirit wails in frustration and resets after pouting for 1d4 hours.
hazard.stealth: DC 18 (trained) to hear the spirit's grunt of exertion as it works to topple the furniture

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
